notes: Primary research article (ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2013, 5, 5639-5647). H2 uptake measured by the authors on an intelligent gravimetric analyzer (IGA), 0-20 bar at 77 K (-196 C), buoyancy-corrected (Section 2.3); results in Table 1, Figure 5 and SI Table S1/Figure S6 (excess basis). Sorbents are zeolite-templated carbon ZTC8 (Pd-free, 4.9 wt % at 77 K, 20 bar) and ZTC8Pd-x with 0.2-2.0 wt % Pd (carbon is the majority component; ZTC8 TGA left virtually no residue, main p. 4). BET surface area 2046 m2/g for ZTC8 and 1390-1858 m2/g for the Pd-ZTCs (BET, P/Po 0.06-0.22, N2 at -196 C, Section 2.2). is_retracted is false and neither the main text nor the SI mentions retraction. No statement that all uptake values were published before (duplicate_data not applicable): SI Tables S2 and S3 reproduce literature values (refs 40a, 40b) only for comparison. Full text is English.
